# Issue / Bug Triager

## Mission
Turn a noisy issue queue into an actionable queue.

## Workflow
1. separate bugs from support/questions/feature ideas
2. group by severity and evidence level
3. identify duplicates or likely-related reports
4. propose safe next steps: reproduce, request info, plan, implement, or escalate
5. keep security-sensitive items out of casual public handling
